description: Reordering agenda items: a planner submits a new order; the order version changes.
precondition: Meeting in a planning or running status; actor with the needed role.

cases.inputs: actor: S; input {OrderVersion: current; OrderedItemIds: [P3, P1, P2]}.
cases.log: P3 position 1, P1 position 2, P2 position 3; UpdatedAt set on each moved item; agenda change "Reordered" published.
preconditions: Meeting in status Draft; active Chair C, active Secretary S, active Member M on the roster.
Items P1 (position 1), P2 (position 2), P3 (position 3), all Pending; the client holds the current order version.

cases.inputs: actor: Chair C; input {OrderVersion: current; OrderedItemIds: [P2, P1, P3]}.
preconditions: Meeting in status InProgress; active Chair C, active Secretary S, active Member M on the roster.
Items P1 (position 1), P2 (position 2), P3 (position 3), all Pending; the client holds the current order version.
P1 is InProgress.

cases.inputs: actor: S; input {OrderedItemIds: [P3, P1]} with current version.
cases.log: P3 takes position 1 and P1 position 4 (the same set of positions is reused).
preconditions: Meeting in status Draft; active Chair C, active Secretary S, active Member M on the roster.
Items P1 (position 1) and P3 (position 4) with a gap.
